summary: GLM-5.3 (744B) serves at TP6 on six GPUs, with DCP2 and DCP3 for longer contexts
compatibility: TP sizes that divide the model are unchanged. TP6 needs b12x with 352-channel W4A16 tiles (b12x-487).
details: At TP6 the 64 MLA heads are padded to 66 and the 2048 expert channels to 2112 (352 per GPU) with zero weights, for the target and its MTP draft; routed experts that the TP size does not divide are now split at the tail instead of dropping channels.
B12X sparse MLA pads its query heads to whole groups of eight; the FP4-CSF reader writes padded per-rank shards.

Decode context parallelism trusts the driver's peer-to-peer report when VLLM_SKIP_P2P_CHECK is on (the default), as the custom all-reduce does; its cross-process probe of every GPU pair hung DCP2 startup on a six-GPU PCIe host.

GLM-5.3-NVFP4-CSF on 6x RTX PRO 6000 (MTP3, dk preset glm53-csf-tp6 at 94% GPU memory): KV cache 227,520 / 452,223 / 678,336 tokens at DCP1 / DCP2 / DCP3; decode steps/s at C1 66.2 / 54.8 / 51.0; needle retrieval 3/3 at 212K / 436K / 632K tokens.
